question: On a hard mechanics-enriched Corpus-2 sample, does reserve 0.15 preserve progress/solves versus 0.25 while releasing work?
nonDuplication: ETT-010 was success-censored and reached admissible order on 1/20; ETT-011 targets a distinct hard population using mechanics only.

sampleSelection.rule: rank descending by reqInt*100 + mustCrossCount*40 + mustPassCount*20 + flippingFilterCount*15 + reqLen; tie by position; take 20
sampleSelection.policyInput: mechanics-only selection; worker input strips IDs/history

common.workBudgetSemantics: declared main-ladder allocation pool; not an enforced whole-solve ceiling in this run

stoppingRule: run all 20 levels in both arms; no extension/replacement
escalationRule: escalate if no net solve loss and >=5 reached levels show >=5% aggregate work reduction, or any net solve gain

protocolVerification.disposition: not independently preregistered; targeted diagnostic only
